topic: Someone finds their childhood teddy bear at a yard sale
text: I can't believe I found him, my old teddy bear, sitting there quietly among the jumble of forgotten things. The familiar soft, slightly faded brown fur, the gentle button eyes that seem to smile. It's been years since I last thought about him, since I last held him. The world feels a bit warmer now, a little more connected to my past. I can almost hear my mom’s voice, the bedtime stories, the whispered "good night, sweetie" as she tucked me in with my bear. I’m buying him, of course. It feels right, like bringing a piece of my childhood home again.
